title: P2 limit boundary pair
why: Both open Mon 09:00. A closes Tue 09:00 at 480 (not > 480). B closes Tue 09:01: used(1981) = 481, breach at 1981.

title: P3 limit boundary pair
why: Mon-Wed = 1440. A closes Thu 09:00 at 1440. B closes Thu 09:01 at 1441, breach at 4861.

title: a holiday is a date, not a weekday
why: Week 0 Monday is a holiday; week 1 Monday is not. Fri 120 + Mon wk1 09:00-10:00 60 = 180. A recurring-Monday bug gives 120.

title: holiday stamped after now, same day, still applies
why: now = Tue 12:00 (2160). Holiday stamped Tue 15:00 removes all of Tuesday: 480, not 660.

title: holiday at exactly midnight belongs to the new day
why: 1440 is Tue 00:00, so Tuesday is the holiday: 480. Mapping it to Monday gives 60.
